std::optional

template< class T > class optional;(since C++17)

The class template manages an optional contained value, a value that may or may not be present.

Template parameters

T is the type of the value to manage initialization state for. T must meet the requirements of Destructible.

Observers

operator bool reports whether the optional contains a value.

Restrictions

Reference, function, array, and void types are not permitted.

Standards

Available since C++17.
